summary: Amazon.com filed a prospectus supplement (424B5) under Rule 424(b)(5) for a multi-tranche Canadian-dollar-denominated senior unsecured note offering. The offering consists of C$1.25B 3.400% notes due 2029, C$2.5B 3.700% notes due 2031, C$2.0B 4.000% notes due 2033, C$3.5B 4.350% notes due 2036, and C$4.75B 5.000% notes due 2056. Proceeds to Amazon total approximately C$13.934B. The notes rank equally with other senior unsecured debt, are not listed on any exchange, and settlement is T+4 via CDS. There are no special-situation corporate actions; this is a routine debt capital markets transaction.
